policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 9 Feb close (1x4 3.77, 3x6 3.47, 6x9 3.36, 9x12 3.36 vs WIBOR 3M 3.88) price roughly 50bp of NBP cuts within 12 months. The MPC held at 4.00% on 4 Feb; the statement says CPI may fall in Q1 and stay consistent with the target in coming quarters. Glapiński (5 Feb): a March cut if the projection shows nothing worrying; 3.5% possible as the end-point. Kotecki (via PKO, 9 Feb): a March cut very likely.
policy.risk_text: A March cut is the consensus: the risks are the mid-March CPI basket revision, strong wages (Q4 +8.5%) and fiscal slippage; abroad, Iran/oil and US tariffs move the long end.

macro.projection_text: NBP November 2025 projection: CPI 2.9% (2026), 2.5% (2027); the March 2026 projection comes with the 3-4 Mar MPC.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit ~7.0% of GDP; 2026 budget deficit cap PLN 271.7bn (in force; at the Constitutional Tribunal for follow-up review), gross borrowing needs ~PLN 690bn.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~30% (29 Jan) financed; budget accounts PLN 183bn at end-January; Fitch reviews Poland on 27 Feb (after the close) and Moody's on 20 Mar, both with negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 4.00% on 14 Jan and 4 Feb; December CPI 2.4% y/y (final), core 2.7%; 2025 GDP grew 3.6% (30 Jan). Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 9 Feb: Q4 wages rose 8.5% y/y (above forecasts); Glapiński (AlUla) said inflation will stay within target this year, probably below 2.5%; Kotecki sees a March cut as very likely; MoF offered PLN 8-12bn in eight series for 11 Feb. Abroad: markets priced the first Fed cut in June.

calendar.plan_text: MoF February plan (30 Jan): sale auctions on 11, 18 and 25 Feb (PLN 7-12bn each), no switch auction, a 33-week T-bill auction on 6 Feb; January sales were ~PLN 41.6bn incl. additional sales. BGK placed PLN 1bn of FWA0931 (Armed Forces Support Fund) privately (29-30 Jan). JPY 211.6bn priced on 6 Feb (3Y 1.88%, 5Y 2.22%, 10Y 2.90%, 20Y 3.65%); 33-week T-bills PLN 2.6bn at 3.529%. 11 Feb offer (9 Feb): PLN 8-12bn in OK0128, WZ0930, PS0131, NZ0331, IZ0831, DS1033, DS1035 and WS0437.
calendar.timing_text: Within each auction week of the Aug 2025-Feb 2026 sample, yields drifted lower into the auction and the auction-day close was the cheapest point relative to the preceding session, so new buying is best executed at the auction-day close (11, 18 and 25 Feb). January auctions were absorbed with 1.4-1.9x cover. The 3-4 Mar MPC with the new projection is the next event; a 25bp cut is the consensus.

facts.core_text: Regime: the NBP paused at 4.00% with ~50bp more priced, the ECB is on hold at 2.00%, the Fed holds into June, the BoE eases gradually, the CNB and MNB are on hold. (Erste's CDS/spread table for 9 Feb looked stale or inconsistent, so it is not quoted.) Markets see the next Fed cut in June (9 Feb).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK placed PLN 1bn of FWA0931 for the Armed Forces Support Fund privately (29-30 Jan); no FPC auction had been announced for February yet. FPC spreads are tight to POLGB, so pickups are thin.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
